run_body_interaction_simulation: run the MuJoCo body interaction simulation with a robot, cylinder, and fixed box
create_mujoco_model_from_xml: create a MuJoCo physics model from an XML string using load_model_from_xml
build_mjsim_simulation: build an MjSim physics simulator instance from a loaded MuJoCo model
control_actuators_with_ctrl: control simulation actuators by setting sim.data.ctrl values with cosine and sine signals
render_simulation_with_mjviewer: render the MuJoCo simulation frame by frame using MjViewer
